channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Why Xi Is Coming to Washington, and White House TV Feeds Go Dark
item.description: Plus, the man who helped put bugs on the menu.

item.title: NPR: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over deadly 2019 Easter bombings
item.description: The Islamic State group-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

item.title: BBC News: New EU industry rules would damage UK, warns Burnham
item.description: The prime minister says he will raise his concerns when he meets the European Commission President later.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘I’m afraid they’ll bomb the cafe where I work, or bomb me’: a day in the life of a 12-year-old boy in Gaza
item.description: This week, as the war in Gaza approaches its fourth year, the Guardian follows five ordinary Palestinians as they go about their lives. Each tells the story of their day, revealing the terrible toll of the conflict. Rama…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Colombia eases gun restrictions despite fears of more violence
item.description: Colombia has loosened gun laws after more than a decade of restrictions. Some fear it will lead to even more violence.

item.title: Ars Technica: NASA chief: I'm only interested in "good deals" from international partners
item.description: "There was absolutely a time where we were trying to make everyone happy."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Everything You Know About Political Violence Is Probably Wrong
item.description: Public disagreement about whether political violence is rising and who is responsible for it stems not from ideology alone but from competing definitions about what should be counted.

item.title: WIRED Science: After 8 Years in Space, ‘BepiColombo’ Is Finally Approaching Mercury
item.description: Following a difficult journey, the probe will soon begin unraveling the mysteries of Mercury’s magnetic field and internal structure.

item.title: WIRED Business: AI Models Built From Rat Brains Just Got Closer to Reality
item.description: The Biological Computing Company is bringing its AI tools to Amazon Web Services in a major boost for a once-fringe field that aims to marry nature with code.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Lost Descendants of Thomas Jefferson
item.description: Scientists have new proof that the President had children with his enslaved chambermaid Sally Hemings—and that their bloodline endures across the country.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Teyana Taylor Is Now Part of the Calvin Klein Family
item.description: The actress models the brand’s Perfectly Fit Bra in a new campaign.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: How to Spend a Night Out at the New York City Ballet
item.description: NYCB diehards share their favorite seats, the shows on their must-see lists, and where to eat and drink before and after the final curtain.
